_meta.corpus: McGuffey Third Reader (PG#14766, public domain), lessons L04+L05 'Castle-Building' (one self-contained narrative)
_meta.independence: Annotated by reading the raw McGuffey sentence text ONLY; the reader's extraction output for these sentences was NOT consulted while writing these gold relations. Gold keyed to deterministic sentence ids (split_sents on lessons L04,L05). Genuinely independent of the reader.
_meta.standard: SEMANTIC action-agent-patient. A gold relation = (action_lemma, agent_surface_head, patient_surface_head) for an event where an AGENT acts on / creates / perceives a PATIENT/THEME ENTITY. Heads are surface tokens as they appear (pronouns kept: he/she/it/i/you). EXCLUDED: copular be/seem; pure self-motion (go/come/fall/stand/spring/sit) with no distinct patient; speech/report verbs whose complement is a quoted clause (say/said/cry[=exclaim]/ask/answer/retort/exclaim/tell/spoke/call[=summon]); clausal-complement cognition (know/think/wonder/believe/hope/see[=that]); auxiliary/modal-only; passives with no expressed agent; gerund-nominal predications with no explicit agent. Locative/temporal/manner obliques are NOT patients (lived-in-country, sat-on-floor, passed-over-her). Perception look-AT is oblique (not patient); perception see-NP and hear-NP ARE patients. Coordinated patients -> one relation each.
_meta.agent_refs: per-relation list of surface tokens that co-refer to the annotated agent in this story (for the lenient-agent TRIPLE metric only; the PRIMARY metric ignores agent). Characters: Herbert(he/his/him), Joe(he), papa(he), Hetty(she), pussy=cat(she/her/it), the castle/block/kite(it).
_meta.caveat: SINGLE-ANNOTATOR gold; the semantic-patient standard involves judgment calls (e.g. rub-against-castle counted as patient=castle; look-at-book NOT counted). Full gold + full reader output + all matches are reported in metrics so a VET can independently re-annotate the same 46 sentences and recompute.
